text:
If you're still out enjoying that sun, hang on to it a little longer, because tonight's about as easy as it gets. We're partly cloudy and comfortable behind sunset, dropping toward a low around 69 with just a light south breeze. The lake's calm too, one to two foot waves and water sitting at a swimmable 77, so a late paddle or a lakeside dinner is a fine call tonight.

Tomorrow's a different animal. It'll start mostly sunny and warm, pushing toward 89 with the heat index closer to mid-90s, but the afternoon brings scattered showers and thunderstorms as deep moisture and some instability move in. The American model wants it hotter and drier, the European model is much wetter and cooler, so there's real uncertainty in how it plays out, but I'd trust the wetter lean given how humid it'll feel building into it. Get outdoor plans done by early afternoon and keep an eye to the sky after that, especially if you're out on the water.
